title: 不对称 Δ 负载的线电流与二瓦计法
statement: 线电压 380 V 的对称三相电源（正序，U̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° V，故 U̇_AB = 380∠30° V）向不对称三角形负载供电：Z_AB = R = 38 Ω，Z_BC = jX_L = j38 Ω，Z_CA = −jX_C = −j38 Ω。端线上的电流表 A_A、A_B、A_C 测线电流。
另用二瓦计法测功率：W1 的电流线圈串在 A 线、电压线圈接 A、C；W2 的电流线圈串在 B 线、电压线圈接 B、C（功率表图中未画出）。
求线电流 I_A、I_C，两功率表读数之和，并判断两表各自的读数。

questions.ask: 电流表 A_A 的读数 I_A = ?
电流表 A_C 的读数 I_C = ?
两功率表读数之和 W1 + W2 = ?（等于负载吸收的总有功功率，即电阻 R 吸收的功率）
questions.explain: 电感、电容不消耗有功，总有功功率只在 R 上：P = 380²/38 = 3800 W。二瓦计法对任何三相三线制负载（对称或不对称）都给出 W1 + W2 = P。

questions.ask: 两功率表各自的读数是：

hints: Δ 负载每相承受线电压，三相的相电流可以各自用欧姆定律求出：U̇_AB = 380∠30°，U̇_BC = 380∠−90°，U̇_CA = 380∠150°。
线电流用 KCL：İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA，İ_B = İ_BC − İ_AB，İ_C = İ_CA − İ_BC。不对称时不能用 √3 关系。
功率表读数 = Re(电压线圈电压相量 × 电流线圈电流相量的共轭)：W1 = Re(U̇_AC·İ_A*)，W2 = Re(U̇_BC·İ_B*)。
solution: **说明：** 二瓦计法的依据是三线制中 İ_A + İ_B + İ_C = 0，与负载是否对称无关；但单表读数本身没有独立的物理意义。

en.title: Unbalanced Δ load: line currents and the two-wattmeter method
statement: A balanced three-phase source with 380 V line voltage (positive sequence, U̇_A = (380/√3)∠0° V, so U̇_AB = 380∠30° V) feeds an unbalanced delta load: Z_AB = R = 38 Ω, Z_BC = jX_L = j38 Ω, Z_CA = −jX_C = −j38 Ω. Ammeters A_A, A_B and A_C in the lines measure the line currents.

The power is also measured by the two-wattmeter method: W1 has its current coil in line A and its voltage coil between A and C; W2 has its current coil in line B and its voltage coil between B and C (the wattmeters are not drawn).
Find the line currents I_A and I_C, the sum of the two wattmeter readings, and decide the individual readings.

questions.explain: İ_BC = 380∠−90°/(j38) = 10∠180° A; İ_C = İ_CA − İ_BC = (−5 − j8.660) + 10 = 5 − j8.660 = 10∠−60° A. All three phase currents have the same magnitude, yet the line currents are not √3 times larger.

questions.ask: Sum of the two wattmeter readings W1 + W2 = ? (it equals the total real power absorbed by the load, i.e. the power absorbed by R)
questions.explain: The inductor and capacitor absorb no real power, so all of it goes into R: P = 380²/38 = 3800 W. For any three-wire load, balanced or not, the two-wattmeter method gives W1 + W2 = P.

W1 = Re(U̇_AC·İ_A*) = 380 × 19.32 × cos(−30° − 45°) = 7341 × cos75° = 1900 W; W2 = Re(U̇_BC·İ_B*) with İ_B = İ_BC − İ_AB = 19.32∠−165° A, so W2 = 380 × 19.32 × cos(−90° + 165°) = 1900 W. For an unbalanced load the formulas U_L·I_L·cos(φ ± 30°) no longer apply.

hints: Each phase of a Δ load sees a line voltage, so each phase current follows from Ohm's law on its own: U̇_AB = 380∠30°, U̇_BC = 380∠−90°, U̇_CA = 380∠150°.
Line currents by KCL: İ_A = İ_AB − İ_CA, İ_B = İ_BC − İ_AB, İ_C = İ_CA − İ_BC. The √3 rule does not hold for an unbalanced load.
A wattmeter reads Re(voltage-coil voltage phasor × conjugate of current-coil current phasor): W1 = Re(U̇_AC·İ_A*), W2 = Re(U̇_BC·İ_B*).
solution: **3. Total real power.** Only R absorbs real power: P = 10² × 38 = **3800 W**.
**Remark:** the two-wattmeter method rests on İ_A + İ_B + İ_C = 0 in a three-wire system, regardless of balance; but a single reading on its own has no independent physical meaning.
